q5_position.gk_limitation_note: Q5 reports outfield positions (DF/MF/FW) only. Goalkeepers are excluded: the EP framework credits scorers, assist-creators (SCA1) and pre-assist-creators (SCA2), three touchpoints GKs occupy rarely. Top GKs in this dataset post ~0.1 EP/90 vs ~1.1 for top forwards - a structural ratio reflecting the framework's coverage, not the keepers' actual value. Quantifying GK contribution requires a different model (e.g. shot-stopping over expected, distribution value).
